name: exportarr
description: Exportarr allows you to share your Radarr/Sonarr lists with others, without having to give them your Radarr API key, or open external ports to Radarr/Sonarr. :) Others just copy the URL for the genre they want, then use this as an importable list in Sonarr/Radarr. Then, as you add new titles to your Sonarr/Radarr, your friends will see them updated daily in thier Sonarr/Radarr apps.

ports.name: Port
ports.description: The port that you want to access Exportarr on.

variables.name: Radarr URL
variables.description: Fully qualified URL to Radarr, including any non-standard ports. E.G http://n.n.n.n:7878

variables.name: Sonarr URL
variables.description: Fully qualified URL to Sonarr, including any non-standard ports. E.G http://n.n.n.n:8989
